note: Where every shipped source file under patches/ and extensions/ came from. A rule naming a single file wins over the directory rule around it; otherwise each file matches exactly one rule. A ported rule names the upstream repository, the commit it was copied from, the repositories it came through and its licence, and every file's header names a repository of its rule, by URL. Every upstream named here must also appear in NOTICE. ProvenanceTest checks all of it. HushTelegram started from HushThreads at b141524, which started from Hushfacebook at c15d4f79, so most rules name HushThreads and carry on the chain the earlier projects recorded for the same files. A Telegram source named here also has to be allowed by sources/telegram-sources.json.
